description: Source code for JWT (JSON Web Token) creation and signing, supporting RSA and ECDSA algorithms, including base64 encoding, payload handling, and cryptographic signing functions.

methods.name: base64_char
methods.description: Computational implementation of base64 character encoding, optimized for Cortex-M.

methods.name: base64_outch
methods.description: Adds a character to the JWT buffer with overflow detection and null termination.

methods.name: base64_flush
methods.description: Flushes pending base64 bytes, generating 4 characters if three bytes are present.

methods.name: base64_addbyte
methods.description: Adds a byte to the current base64 processing buffer.

methods.name: base64_append_bytes
methods.description: Encodes a sequence of bytes into base64 and adds to the buffer.

methods.name: jwt_add_header
methods.description: Adds a pre-computed JWT header to the buffer based on the signing algorithm.

methods.name: jwt_add_payload
methods.description: Adds payload data (exp, iat, aud) to the JWT, encoding it in base64.

methods.name: jwt_sign
methods.description: Signs the JWT using RSA or ECDSA algorithms, appending the signature to the token.

methods.name: jwt_init_builder
methods.description: Initializes the JWT builder with a buffer and adds the header.
